<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Mirjam Sharon Schüßler — Portfolio</title>
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Syne:wght@300;400;500;600&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<style>
  *, *::before, *::after { box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; padding: 0; }
  :root {
    --bg: #F5F2EE;
    --bg-card: #EFEBE5;
    --text: #2E2E2C;
    --muted: #7A7870;
    --subtle: #B0ADA8;
    --border: rgba(46,46,44,0.1);
    --sans: 'Syne', sans-serif;
  }
  html { scroll-behavior: smooth; }
  body { font-family: var(--sans); background: var(--bg); color: var(--text); font-size: 18px; line-height: 1.7; font-weight: 300; }
  nav {
    position: fixed; top: 0; left: 0; right: 0; z-index: 100;
    display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center;
    padding: 1.2rem 3rem;
    background: rgba(245,242,238,0.93);
    backdrop-filter: blur(14px);
    border-bottom: 0.5px solid var(--border);
  }
  .nav-logo { font-size: 13px; letter-spacing: 0.1em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--text); text-decoration: none; font-weight: 500; }
  .nav-links { display: flex; gap: 2rem; list-style: none; }
  .nav-links a { font-size: 11px; letter-spacing: 0.1em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--muted); text-decoration: none; transition: color 0.2s; }
  .nav-links a:hover { color: var(--text); }
  section { padding: 7rem 3rem; max-width: 1080px; margin: 0 auto; }
  /* HERO */
  #hero { min-height: 100vh; display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: center; padding-top: 9rem; padding-bottom: 4rem; }
  .hero-label { font-size: 11px; letter-spacing: 0.2em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--subtle); margin-bottom: 1.75rem; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 1rem; }
  .hero-label::before { content: ''; width: 2.5rem; height: 0.5px; background: var(--subtle); }
  h1 { font-size: clamp(2.8rem, 6vw, 5rem); font-weight: 500; line-height: 1.05; letter-spacing: -0.02em; margin-bottom: 0.25rem; }
  .hero-sub-name { font-size: clamp(1.5rem, 3vw, 2.4rem); font-weight: 300; color: var(--muted); letter-spacing: -0.01em; margin-bottom: 2.5rem; }
  .hero-desc { font-size: 14px; color: var(--muted); max-width: 44ch; line-height: 1.75; margin-bottom: 2.5rem; font-weight: 300; }
  .hero-pills { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 0.5rem; margin-bottom: 3rem; }
  .pill { font-size: 11px; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; padding: 0.35rem 1rem; border: 0.5px solid var(--border); border-radius: 2rem; color: var(--muted); }
  .btn { display: inline-block; padding: 0.85rem 2.2rem; background: var(--text); color: var(--bg); font-family: var(--sans); font-size: 11px; letter-spacing: 0.1em; text-transform: uppercase; text-decoration: none; font-weight: 500; border-radius: 2rem; transition: opacity 0.2s; }
  .btn:hover { opacity: 0.7; }
  .rule { width: 100%; max-width: 1080px; margin: 0 auto; height: 0.5px; background: var(--border); }
  .sec-label { font-size: 10px; letter-spacing: 0.2em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--subtle); margin-bottom: 0.85rem; }
  h2 { font-size: clamp(1.8rem, 3.5vw, 2.6rem); font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: -0.02em; line-height: 1.1; margin-bottom: 3rem; }
  /* ABOUT */
  .about-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 220px 1fr; gap: 5rem; align-items: start; }
  .avatar { width: 220px; height: 260px; border-radius: 4px; overflow: hidden; flex-shrink: 0; }
  .avatar img { width: 100%; height: 100%; object-fit: cover; object-position: center top; }
  .about-right h2 { margin-bottom: 1.25rem; }
  .about-right p { color: var(--muted); margin-bottom: 1.1rem; font-size: 14px; }
  .about-right p strong { color: var(--text); font-weight: 500; }
  .hobby-tags { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 0.4rem; margin-top: 1.5rem; }
  .hobby-tag { font-size: 11px; letter-spacing: 0.06em; color: var(--subtle); background: var(--bg-card); padding: 0.25rem 0.8rem; border-radius: 2rem; }
  /* EXPERIENCE */
  .exp-item { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 160px 1fr; gap: 2rem; padding: 2rem 0; border-bottom: 0.5px solid var(--border); }
  .exp-item:first-child { border-top: 0.5px solid var(--border); }
  .exp-time { font-size: 11px; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--subtle); padding-top: 0.2rem; }
  .exp-role { font-size: 15px; font-weight: 500; margin-bottom: 0.2rem; letter-spacing: -0.01em; }
  .exp-company { font-size: 13px; color: var(--muted); margin-bottom: 0.75rem; }
  .exp-bullets { list-style: none; padding: 0; }
  .exp-bullets li { font-size: 13px; color: var(--muted); line-height: 1.6; padding-left: 1rem; position: relative; margin-bottom: 0.2rem; }
  .exp-bullets li::before { content: '–'; position: absolute; left: 0; color: var(--subtle); }
  /* SKILLS */
  .skills-outer { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 4rem; }
  .skills-group { margin-bottom: 2rem; }
  .skills-group-label { font-size: 10px; letter-spacing: 0.18em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--subtle); margin-bottom: 0.75rem; }
  .skill-row { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; padding: 0.6rem 0; border-bottom: 0.5px solid var(--border); font-size: 13px; }
  .dots { display: flex; gap: 4px; }
  .d { width: 5px; height: 5px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--border); }
  .d.on { background: var(--text); }
  /* PROJECTS */
  .proj-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(280px, 1fr)); gap: 1.5rem; }
  .proj-card { background: var(--bg-card); border: 0.5px solid var(--border); border-radius: 4px; padding: 1.75rem; transition: transform 0.2s; }
  .proj-card:hover { transform: translateY(-3px); }
  .proj-year { font-size: 11px; letter-spacing: 0.1em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--subtle); margin-bottom: 0.5rem; }
  .proj-name { font-size: 15px; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: -0.01em; margin-bottom: 0.4rem; }
  .proj-client { font-size: 12px; color: var(--subtle); margin-bottom: 0.75rem; letter-spacing: 0.04em; text-transform: uppercase; }
  .proj-desc { font-size: 13px; color: var(--muted); line-height: 1.6; }
  .proj-tag { display: inline-block; font-size: 10px; letter-spacing: 0.06em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--subtle); border: 0.5px solid var(--border); border-radius: 2rem; padding: 0.2rem 0.6rem; margin-top: 0.75rem; margin-right: 0.3rem; }
  /* EDUCATION */
  .edu-item { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 160px 1fr; gap: 2rem; padding: 1.5rem 0; border-bottom: 0.5px solid var(--border); }
  .edu-item:first-child { border-top: 0.5px solid var(--border); }
  .edu-year { font-size: 11px; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--subtle); padding-top: 0.15rem; }
  .edu-title { font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; margin-bottom: 0.15rem; }
  .edu-place { font-size: 13px; color: var(--muted); }
  .edu-note { font-size: 12px; color: var(--subtle); margin-top: 0.2rem; }
  .cert-row { display: flex; align-items: baseline; gap: 1.5rem; padding: 1rem 0; border-bottom: 0.5px solid var(--border); font-size: 13px; }
  .cert-row:first-child { border-top: 0.5px solid var(--border); }
  .cert-year { font-size: 11px; color: var(--subtle); letter-spacing: 0.08em; min-width: 40px; }
  .cert-name { font-weight: 500; }
  .cert-place { font-size: 12px; color: var(--muted); margin-top: 0.1rem; }
  /* CONTACT */
  #contact { text-align: center; }
  .contact-sub { color: var(--muted); font-size: 14px; max-width: 38ch; margin: 0 auto 3rem; }
  .contact-row { display: flex; justify-content: center; gap: 1rem; flex-wrap: wrap; }
  .contact-btn { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.5rem; font-size: 12px; letter-spacing: 0.06em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--text); text-decoration: none; padding: 0.7rem 1.5rem; border: 0.5px solid var(--border); border-radius: 2rem; font-family: var(--sans); font-weight: 400; transition: background 0.2s, color 0.2s; }
  .contact-btn:hover { background: var(--text); color: var(--bg); }
  .contact-btn svg { width: 15px; height: 15px; stroke: currentColor; fill: none; stroke-width: 1.5; }
  footer { text-align: center; padding: 2.5rem; font-size: 11px; color: var(--subtle); letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; border-top: 0.5px solid var(--border); }
  .lang-row { display: flex; gap: 2rem; margin-top: 1.5rem; }
  .lang-item { font-size: 13px; color: var(--muted); }
  .lang-item strong { color: var(--text); font-weight: 500; display: block; }
</style>
</head>

<section id="hero">

  <h1>Hi, I'm Sharon.</h1>
  <div class="hero-sub-name"><p>Brand strategist, UX designer, and creative director rolled into one.</p><p>I build things that look good, feel right, and actually work.</p></div>
  <div class="hero-pills">

<section id="about">
  <div class="about-grid">
    <div class="avatar">
      <img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="Mirjam Sharon Schüßler" />
    </div>
    <div class="about-right">
      <div class="sec-label">About</div>
      <h2>Ten years in.<br>Still obsessed with growing each day.</h2>
      <p>I'm Mirjam — a designer, strategist, and creative generalist who's spent the last decade working where brand, UX, and marketing collide. I've led teams, shipped products, built design systems from scratch, and run campaigns that actually moved the needle.</p>
      <p>Right now I'm Brand Experience Lead at APARI Software in UK, where I own the visual and strategic identity of the product — from positioning to pixels. Before that, I spent years in UX at Eplan and in content and art direction at Salt Works, which means I'm equally comfortable in a design sprint and on a film set.</p>
      <p>I care about work that's thoughtful, well-crafted, and built to last. If that sounds like what you're looking for, let's talk.</p>
      <div class="lang-row">
        <div class="lang-item"><strong>German</strong>Native</div>
        <div class="lang-item"><strong>English</strong>Fluent (C1/C2)</div>
        <div class="lang-item"><strong>Spanish</strong>Basic</div>
      </div>
      <div class="hobby-tags">

        <span class="hobby-tag">#sketching</span>
        <span class="hobby-tag">#painting</span>
        <span class="hobby-tag">#traveler</span>
        <span class="hobby-tag">#bookworm</span>
        <span class="hobby-tag">#gaming</span>
        <span class="hobby-tag">#concerts</span>
        <span class="hobby-tag">#singer</span>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>

<section id="projects">
  <div class="sec-label">Voluntary Work · Side Projects</div>
  <h2>The best way to find yourself is to lose yourself in the service of others.</h2>
  <p style="color: var(--muted); font-size: 14px; max-width: 52ch; margin-bottom: 3rem; margin-top: -1.5rem;">These projects were entirely unpaid — taken on because the briefs were interesting, the causes worth it, or both.</p>
  <div class="proj-grid">
    <div class="proj-card">
      <div class="proj-year">2016</div>
      <div class="proj-name">ICAN Germany</div>
      <div class="proj-client">Non-profit · Campaign</div>
      <p class="proj-desc">Developed the full crossmedia campaign concept and design for ICAN Germany — the German branch of the Nobel Peace Prize–winning International Campaign to Abolish Nuclear Weapons.</p>
      <span class="proj-tag">Campaign</span><span class="proj-tag">Crossmedia</span><span class="proj-tag">Design</span>
    </div>
    <div class="proj-card">
      <div class="proj-year">2016</div>
      <div class="proj-name">Oberwerth Relaunch</div>
      <div class="proj-client">Brand · Crossmedia</div>
      <p class="proj-desc">Took the brand from the ground up — full relaunch concept spanning identity, messaging, and visual language across every channel.</p>
      <span class="proj-tag">Relaunch</span><span class="proj-tag">Branding</span><span class="proj-tag">Crossmedia</span>
    </div>
    <div class="proj-card">
      <div class="proj-year">2016</div>
      <div class="proj-name">Highländer Reisen</div>
      <div class="proj-client">Brand Identity</div>
      <p class="proj-desc">Designed a fresh brand icon and all supporting business materials for this travel company — clean, considered, and ready to travel.</p>
      <span class="proj-tag">Logo</span><span class="proj-tag">Brand Design</span><span class="proj-tag">Print</span>
    </div>
    <div class="proj-card">
      <div class="proj-year">2016</div>
      <div class="proj-name">POWWOWYOU Festival</div>
      <div class="proj-client">Stadt Solingen · Festival Identity</div>
      <p class="proj-desc">Full rebrand and crossmedia campaign for this city-run cultural festival. Volunteered across concept, design, and hands-on production — start to finish.</p>
      <span class="proj-tag">Rebranding</span><span class="proj-tag">Campaign</span><span class="proj-tag">Festival</span>
    </div>
    <div class="proj-card">
      <div class="proj-year">2015</div>
      <div class="proj-name">Pokal der Unternehmen</div>
      <div class="proj-client">Video Production</div>
      <p class="proj-desc">Produced the image film, making-of, and trailer for this annual business sports event. Handled everything from shoot to final cut.</p>
      <span class="proj-tag">Video</span><span class="proj-tag">Film</span><span class="proj-tag">Event</span>
    </div>
    <div class="proj-card">
      <div class="proj-year">2015</div>

      <div class="proj-client">Event · Editorial</div>

</section>
